I'm a BCA graduate based in Kerala, India, with a strong interest in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, threat intelligence, and security operations. My background in software development helps me understand both how applications are built — and how they can be attacked and secured.

I completed my Bachelor of Computer Applications at BVM Holy Cross College, Cherpunkal, affiliated with Mahatma Gandhi University. I'm currently developing my skills across networking, Linux, penetration testing, threat intelligence, security monitoring, and AI-assisted security systems. I enjoy building practical projects rather than limiting myself to theory, with a long-term goal of working as a cybersecurity analyst and progressing into advanced security engineering.

## Projects

### CarePlus — Hospital Appointment Booking System

Status: Completed
Timeline: Completed
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/careplus-hospital-appointment-booking-system
Stack: PHP, MariaDB

A full-stack hospital appointment management platform to manage patients, doctors, appointments, and administrative workflows.

Full-stack appointment management for patients, doctors and admins

CarePlus is a full-stack hospital appointment booking system built around the daily workflows of a small hospital: patients book appointments, doctors manage their schedules, and administrators oversee doctors, patients and bookings from one place.

The project was built to practise complete CRUD application design — authentication, role-aware dashboards, relational data modelling and a database-backed booking flow — rather than a single-page demo.

Highlights:
- Patient, doctor and admin workflows
- Appointment booking backed by a relational schema
- Role-aware dashboards


### Kerala Tourism Website

Status: Completed
Timeline: Completed
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/kerala-tourism-website
Stack: Django, Python

A tourism platform showcasing Kerala's destinations, attractions, and travel information with a dynamic backend.

Destination and travel information platform

A tourism platform for exploring Kerala's destinations and travel information. The site pairs a browsable front end with a dynamic Django backend, so destination content is managed as structured data instead of hand-written pages.

Highlights:
- Structured destination content
- Server-rendered Django views


### Precision Builders — Intelligent Construction Platform

Status: Completed
Timeline: Completed
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/precision-builders-intelligent-construction-platform
Stack: Python, Django, Machine Learning, SQLite

A construction collaboration platform combining project management with ML-based cost and time prediction to assist planning.

Project collaboration with ML-based cost and time prediction

Precision Builders combines construction project management with machine-learning estimates for cost and schedule. The platform is aimed at planning: teams keep project information in one place and use model predictions as a second opinion on cost and duration.

It was an exercise in connecting a conventional Django application to a scikit-learn prediction pipeline, including preparing training data and surfacing predictions inside the UI.

Highlights:
- Construction project management workflow
- ML-assisted cost and time estimates


### OffGrid — E-Commerce Clothing Store

Status: Ongoing
Timeline: Ongoing
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/offgrid-e-commerce-clothing-store
Stack: Python, Django, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Razorpay

A full-featured Django clothing store: product management, filtering, sorting, stock indicators, reviews, ratings, coupons, delivery estimates, and Razorpay payments.

Django storefront with catalogue, reviews, coupons and payments

OffGrid is a complete clothing storefront built with Django. The catalogue supports filtering and sorting, stock indicators, product reviews and ratings, coupon codes, delivery estimates and Razorpay checkout.

The interesting part is the depth: a real storefront needs inventory state, pricing rules, order handling and payment integration to work together, and this project is where those pieces are being built out.

Highlights:
- Catalogue filtering, sorting and stock state
- Reviews, ratings and coupons
- Razorpay payment integration


### ASI — AI Security Platform

Status: Ongoing
Timeline: Ongoing
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/asi-ai-security-platform
Stack: Python, AI/ML, Computer Vision, Raspberry Pi

An intelligent physical-security platform combining cameras, sensors, and network monitoring to detect suspicious activity and generate alerts.

Camera, sensor and network monitoring with AI alerts

ASI is an AI security platform that brings cameras, sensors and network monitoring into one detection pipeline. Instead of treating each source separately, it correlates what the sensors see and generates alerts for activity that looks suspicious.

The project sits at the intersection of computer vision, sensor input and security monitoring — the same overlap between physical and digital security that the rest of this portfolio explores.

Highlights:
- Camera and sensor fusion pipeline
- AI-assisted suspicious-activity alerts


### Threat Intelligence Dashboard

Status: Ongoing
Timeline: Ongoing
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/threat-intelligence-dashboard
Stack: Python, Threat Intel APIs

A security dashboard for collecting, processing, and visualizing threat intel — helping analysts monitor IOCs, suspicious infrastructure, and emerging threats.

Collect, process and visualise threat intelligence

A dashboard for gathering threat intelligence feeds, processing indicators and presenting them in a form an analyst can scan quickly. It focuses on the collector-to-visualisation path: normalise incoming IOCs, track suspicious infrastructure and make emerging threats visible without digging through raw feeds.

Highlights:
- IOC collection and normalisation
- Analyst-facing threat visualisation


### JARVIS — Personal AI Assistant

Status: Ongoing
Timeline: Ongoing
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/jarvis-personal-ai-assistant
Stack: Python, Faster-Whisper, Silero VAD, LLMs

A local personal AI assistant focused on natural voice interaction, speech recognition, and future integration with security workflows.

Local voice assistant with speech recognition

JARVIS is a locally running assistant built around voice interaction: speech recognition, voice activity detection and an LLM for responses. Running locally keeps audio off third-party services and makes the assistant available without an internet round trip.

The long-term direction is to connect it to security workflows, so routine queries and lab tasks can be handled conversationally.

Highlights:
- Local speech-to-text with Faster-Whisper
- Voice activity detection with Silero VAD
- Local LLM responses


### AI-Based Property Security & Sensor Fusion

Status: Ongoing
Timeline: Ongoing
URL: https://vishnuanilkumar.in/projects/ai-based-property-security-sensor-fusion
Stack: AI/ML, mmWave Radar, Raspberry Pi, Sensor Fusion

Research combining cameras, mmWave radar, and sensors with AI to identify meaningful human movement vs. normal environmental activity.

Telling human movement apart from environmental noise

A research build that combines cameras, mmWave radar and other sensors with AI to distinguish meaningful human movement from ordinary environmental activity. The hard problem is false positives: a curtain moving in the wind should not trigger the same response as a person crossing a room.

The project explores sensor fusion as a way to make that distinction more reliable than any single sensor on its own.

Highlights:
- Multi-sensor fusion
- Human movement vs. environmental noise classification

AI-assisted alert triage and investigation

A planned SOC platform that uses AI to help with the part of analyst work that scales badly: reading every alert, ranking what matters and correlating indicators before an investigation starts. The goal is assistance for the analyst, not replacement of judgement.
